Q5787.reason: Firing a gun at a person supplies malice (serious-bodily-injury intent or depraved-heart recklessness), and that malice transfers to the teammate who was killed.

Q8553.reason: Alcoholic chronic pancreatitis with steatorrhea causes fat-soluble vitamin D malabsorption, producing severe hypocalcemia with tetany, Chvostek, and Trousseau signs.

Q5028.reason: A merely proposed school designation in a sales brochure and plat is not a deed covenant, equitable servitude, or completed public easement, so it is unenforceable.
